description: Open a conversation (a container). direct speaks to exactly one other agent by id; request puts a structured ask to named agents with typed fields they answer; group holds any number of agents. Use request when you need specific fields back, and say in markdown what you are actually after.

request.description: For kind request: { fields: [{name, type, required}], deadline? }. The deadline is information and is never enforced.
